function.name: update_user_profile
function.description: Updates the user profile with the provided details. If certain details are not provided, existing information is retained. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The updated email address for the user.

phone.description: The updated phone number for the user in E.164 format, such as '+1234567890'.

preferences.description: The updated preferences for the user. If not provided, the default preferences will be used.

newsletter_subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the newsletter.

birthdate.description: The updated birthdate of the user in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

• Summarize articles or reports
• Provide quick facts or definitions | | **Writing & Editing** | • Draft emails, letters, essays, or reports
• Proofread and suggest improvements
• Generate creative content (stories, poems, jokes) | | **Learning & Tutoring** | • Explain concepts in math, physics, programming, etc.
• Create study guides or flashcards
• Offer practice problems and solutions | | **Programming Help** | • Write code snippets in Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, etc.
• Debug errors and explain error messages
• Suggest best practices and design patterns | | **Productivity & Planning** | • Create to‑do lists, schedules, or project plans
• Set reminders and track progress
• Offer time‑management tips | | **Travel & Lifestyle** | • Plan itineraries and recommend attractions
• Suggest recipes based on ingredients or dietary needs
• Offer fitness or wellness advice | | **Entertainment & Fun** | • Play text‑based games (trivia, riddles, choose‑your‑own adventure)
• Recommend books, movies, or music based on preferences | | **Miscellaneous** | • Translate short phrases between many languages
• Convert units or currencies
• Generate random facts or trivia | If you have something specific in mind, just let me know and I’ll tailor my response to fit your needs!
